title: Horizon Pulse Solana USDC accepts entry (x402 v2, exact)
description: Second entry in PAYMENT-REQUIRED.accepts on every paid route when HP_SOLANA_ENABLED=true (Base/CDP exact entry is always first and unchanged). Facilitated by PayAI. PayAI-facilitated Solana sales do NOT count toward the Coinbase Bazaar settlement window; CDP/Base remains the Bazaar-indexed entry.

amount.description: Atomic USDC (6 decimals); always equal to the Base entry's amount on the same route.

asset.description: Circle USDC mint on Solana mainnet (SPL Token program, 6 decimals).

payTo.description: Pinned Solana payout owner; payment credits its USDC associated token account.
